content.description: User-authorized feedback text. Describe the issue, expected behavior and reproduction steps; exclude tokens, passwords and unrelated private data.

pagePath.description: Optional affected IELTS Buddy page path, without credentials or sensitive query parameters.

limit.description: Maximum route course nodes to return.

subject.description: Optional IELTS subject filter. Empty returns the full-course route.

view.description: Full ordered route nodes, or a compact progress-only view.

courseId.description: Optional exact course id returned by the learning route.

limit.description: Maximum number of exact course sections to return.

page.description: Result page. Use nextPage from the preceding search.

search.description: Optional course, section, or video keyword.

tagQueries.description: Literal course labels or user-mentioned learning terms used to match course tags.

query.description: Optional asset title or content keyword.

contentRef.description: Stable contentRef returned by the owning resource Domain.

query.description: Search saved text, meaning, or source context. A complete word also returns its public dictionary page when available, even if not saved. Empty lists entries.

text.description: Word, phrase, or sentence to save.

meaning.description: Meaning or sentence translation supplied by the assistant.

sourcePartId.description: Optional exact published question Part id this entry was collected from. Copy a known id; omit for ordinary conversation additions.

items.description: One or more entries. Repeated additions reuse the entry and update a supplied nonempty meaning.

id.description: Copy the exact id returned by vocabulary search or add.

meaning.description: Meaning or sentence translation; empty clears it.

id.description: Copy the exact id returned by vocabulary search or add.

tag.description: Optional published guide tag or category.

offset.description: Character offset returned by the preceding read.

reportIds.description: Optional exact prediction-record ids returned by an earlier search.

kind.description: Prediction record kind: dated exam reports or a rolling ranking snapshot.

query.description: Optional recall, venue, source, or candidate-question keyword.

source.description: Optional prediction source slug, such as nine-score.

testMonth.description: Optional exam month in YYYY-MM; use it instead of one call per day.

cursor.description: Cursor returned by the previous practice.search_parts call.

excludePartIds.description: Part ids the local Agent has ruled out for this selection.

partNumber.description: Exact IELTS Part or Section number, such as listening Section 1.

questionType.description: Optional Part format: blank when all slots are fill-in, choice when all slots are selected-response.

requiresAudio.description: Require a published listening Part with a configured audio URL. Use true for listening practice recommendations.

preferUnseen.description: Whether the caller explicitly wants unseen parts before previously attempted parts.

sort.description: Catalog order or latest-first order chosen by the caller.

tagIds.description: Exact taxonomy tag ids resolved by practice.list_taxonomy.

tagQueries.description: Literal user-mentioned taxonomy terms. The Tool resolves them to exact tag ids before filtering.

excludePartIds.description: Part ids already ruled out during this selection.

hardTagQueries.description: Only literal taxonomy constraints the user explicitly requested. These filters are strict, not inferred from the query.

partNumber.description: Exact IELTS Part or Section number when the learner specifies one.

preferUnseen.description: Prefer an unseen Part when relevance is otherwise comparable.

questionType.description: Optional Part format: blank when all slots are fill-in, choice when all slots are selected-response.

query.description: The learner's original keywords or content. Preserve it verbatim; do not convert it into taxonomy filters.

requiresAudio.description: Require a published listening Part with a configured audio URL. Use true for listening practice recommendations.

limit.description: Maximum number of dictation-ready listening materials to return.

offset.description: Pagination offset returned by the preceding search.

partNumber.description: Exact IELTS listening Part or Section number.

search.description: Keywords in the title, description, or listening transcript and translation.

tagQueries.description: Literal user-mentioned tags inherited from the listening Part, such as a topic, book, or test set. Use partNumber for Part/Section 1–4.

limit.description: Maximum number of submitted dictation attempts to return.

offset.description: Pagination offset returned by the preceding call.

partId.description: Optional exact listening Part id used to filter attempts.

attemptId.description: Exact attempt id returned by dictation.recent_attempts.

offset.description: Line offset returned by the preceding call.

difficulty.description: Optional difficulty filter used to calculate available counts.

includeCourseLinked.description: Whether availability counts include course-linked parts.

search.description: Optional question search text used to calculate available counts.

tagIds.description: Currently selected tag ids used to calculate dependent availability.

tagQueries.description: User-mentioned question-bank category, complete resource-set name, or other taxonomy terms used to find exact tag ids before searching practice.

partId.description: Practice part id returned by practice.search_parts.

query.description: Optional title, story, or tag keyword.

offset.description: Use nextOffset even when a page has no reviewable records.

includeMaterial.description: Include a bounded snapshot of the completed part's original material when local evidence analysis needs it.

limit.description: Maximum review items returned in this page.

maxMaterialChars.description: Maximum combined characters returned for original material.

offset.description: Pagination offset returned by the preceding review call.

scope.description: Return incorrect objective items, or every available submitted response.

target.description: Exact review target returned by review.recent_activity.

dateFrom.description: Optional inclusive local date in YYYY-MM-DD. Explicit dates use the Asia/Shanghai calendar and override timeRange.

dateTo.description: Optional inclusive local date in YYYY-MM-DD. Explicit dates use the Asia/Shanghai calendar and override timeRange.

offset.description: Pagination offset returned by the preceding call.

status.description: Optional record status. Empty returns all statuses.

subject.description: Optional subject filter. Empty returns every subject.

timeRange.description: Relative record range in the Asia/Shanghai calendar. Ignored when dateFrom or dateTo is supplied.

category.description: Optional paper category. Empty searches every category.

limit.description: Maximum number of available mock papers to return.

maxDurationMinutes.description: Maximum duration in minutes. Zero disables the duration filter.

offset.description: Pagination offset returned by the preceding search.

query.description: Optional title, source, category, or level keyword.

subjects.description: Subjects every returned paper must contain. Pass all four for a full mock.

partIds.description: Exact Part ids returned by practice.search_parts.

title.description: Name of the reusable mock paper.

cursor.description: Continue with nextCursor from the preceding page; leave absent on the first page.

kinds.description: Activity kinds to include. Empty includes all kinds.

dataVersion.description: Previously saved dataVersion for this account and API origin. Omit unless a complete local snapshot exists.

search.description: Literal keywords in the title or note.

date.description: Optional calendar date in Asia/Shanghai; a date alone needs no reminder time.

time.description: Optional HH:mm in Asia/Shanghai. Requires date; schedules a reminder.
